findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 17 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 120 questions numbered 1-120; by section: 17.1 19, 17.2 20, 17.3 8, 17.4 14, 17.5 15, 17.6 13, 17.7 13, 17.8 18. Keys: {'a': 30, 'b': 30, 'c': 30, 'd': 30}.

Covers every section 17.1-17.8 in order (properties and trends, reactivity, reactions with oxygen, water and acids, comparison with Group 1, thermal decomposition of carbonates and nitrates, solubility of sulphates and hydroxides, complex ions, Dow process, quicklime, uses). Data questions read the chapter's Tables 17.1, 17.3 and 17.4; small mass questions give the molar masses in the question; all numbers recomputed in Python. E° values of Be and Mg are not asked (only the trend); lime kiln temperature from the text (900-1000 °C).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
